title: Negotiating scope and deadlines
intro: Instead of a flat no, offer a trade: more time for more scope, or less scope to keep the date.
introNative: सीधा "no" कहने की बजाय एक trade offer करें: ज़्यादा scope के लिए ज़्यादा time, या date बनाए रखने के लिए कम scope।

phrases.text: If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.
phrases.native: अगर हम deadline को 30 तारीख तक shift कर दें, तो हम reporting module भी include कर सकते हैं।
phrases.note: "If…, we can…" offers a trade instead of a refusal.

phrases.text: Could we prioritise the checkout flow for this sprint?
phrases.native: क्या हम इस sprint के लिए checkout flow को priority दे सकते हैं?
phrases.note: UK spelling is "prioritise"; US spelling is "prioritize".

phrases.text: We could move the dashboard to phase two.
phrases.native: हम dashboard को phase two में ले जा सकते हैं।
phrases.note: Moving work to a later phase keeps the current date safe.

phrases.text: To be realistic, we can't deliver all ten stories by Friday.
phrases.native: Realistic होकर कहूँ तो, हम शुक्रवार तक सभी दस stories deliver नहीं कर सकते।
phrases.note: Being honest early prevents bigger problems later.

phrases.text: Which of these features matters most to your users?
phrases.native: इनमें से कौन-सा feature आपके users के लिए सबसे ज़्यादा मायने रखता है?
phrases.note: Ask the client to choose, so the priorities are clear.

steps.prompt: The client wants the reporting module in this release, but there isn't enough time. What do you say?
steps.promptNative: Client को इस release में reporting module चाहिए, पर इतना time नहीं है। आप क्या कहेंगे?
options: Not possible, the deadline is too close.
If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.
We will try to adjust and do it somehow.
steps.answer: If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.
steps.explanation: Offer a trade, so the client can make the decision.
steps.explanationNative: एक trade offer कीजिए, ताकि decision client खुद ले सकें।

steps.promptNative: क्या हम इस sprint के लिए checkout flow को priority दे सकते हैं?
steps.answer: Could we prioritise the checkout flow for this sprint?

steps.audioText: We could move the dashboard to phase two.
options: We could move the dashboard to page two.
We could move the dashboard to phase two.
We couldn't move the dashboard to phase two.
steps.answer: We could move the dashboard to phase two.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Can we prepone the release to Monday?
options: Can we prepone the release to Monday?
Can we bring the release forward to Monday?
Can we pre-pone the release to Monday?
Can we advance the release before to Monday?
steps.answer: Can we bring the release forward to Monday?
steps.explanation: "Prepone" is only used in India; say "bring forward" or "move it earlier".
steps.explanationNative: "Prepone" सिर्फ़ India में इस्तेमाल होता है; "bring forward" या "move it earlier" कहें।

steps.prompt: The client sends ten new user stories and wants them all by Friday. How do you start?
steps.promptNative: Client दस नई user stories भेजते हैं और सब शुक्रवार तक चाहते हैं। आप बात कैसे शुरू करेंगे?
options: Ten stories? Impossible, no way.
Yes, we will do the needful.
To be realistic, we can't deliver all ten stories by Friday.
steps.answer: To be realistic, we can't deliver all ten stories by Friday.
steps.explanation: Be honest and specific early, then discuss the options.
steps.explanationNative: शुरू में ही honest और specific रहिए, फिर options पर बात कीजिए।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Please do the needful and extend the deadline.
options: Please do the needful and extend the deadline.
Could you extend the deadline by one week?
Please do needful and extend deadline.
Kindly do the needful for extending the deadline.
steps.answer: Could you extend the deadline by one week?
steps.explanation: "Do the needful" is vague and old-fashioned; ask clearly for what you need.
steps.explanationNative: "Do the needful" vague और पुराने ज़माने का लगता है; आपको जो चाहिए वह साफ़-साफ़ माँगिए।

steps.promptNative: इनमें से कौन-सा feature आपके users के लिए सबसे ज़्यादा मायने रखता है?
steps.answer: Which of these features matters most to your users?

steps.audioText: If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.
options: If we move the deadline to the 13th, we can include the reporting module.
If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can't include the reporting module.
If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.
steps.answer: If we move the deadline to the 30th, we can include the reporting module.

steps.prompt: Think of a deadline on your project that is too tight. Out loud, negotiate in 3 sentences: be realistic, offer a trade, and ask the client what matters most.
steps.promptNative: अपने project की किसी बहुत tight deadline के बारे में सोचिए। 3 sentences में बोलकर negotiate कीजिए: realistic रहिए, एक trade offer कीजिए, और client से पूछिए कि उनके लिए सबसे ज़रूरी क्या है।
